description: This file defines an abstract class ShapeRenderer used for rendering shape objects (images, textframes, charts) into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for rendering shape attributes such as position, size, fill, line style, and wrapping, as well as managing RTF control sequences for shape properties.

classes.name: ShapeRenderer
classes.description: Abstract base class for rendering shape objects to RTF, providing methods for rendering shape attributes, positions, and formatting controls.

methods.name: StartShapeArea
methods.description: Begins the RTF content for a shape description.

methods.name: RenderShapeAttributes
methods.description: Renders common shape attributes such as position, wrapping, and formatting.

methods.name: RenderFillFormat
methods.description: Renders the fill color and visibility of the shape.

methods.name: GetLineWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the line width for the shape's border.

methods.name: RenderLineFormat
methods.description: Renders the line (border) style of the shape.

methods.name: RenderTopPosition
methods.description: Renders the vertical position of the shape.

methods.name: RenderLeftPosition
methods.description: Renders the horizontal position of the shape.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Returns the shape's height.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Returns the shape's width.

methods.name: EndShapeArea
methods.description: Ends the RTF content for the shape description.

methods.name: RenderInParagraph
methods.description: Determines if the shape should be embedded in a paragraph.

methods.name: RenderParagraphAttributes
methods.description: Renders paragraph attributes for shape placement.

methods.name: RenderParagraphDistances
methods.description: Renders space before and after the paragraph.

methods.name: RenderParagraphAlignment
methods.description: Renders paragraph alignment based on shape position.

methods.name: RenderRelativeHorizontal
methods.description: Renders the relative horizontal positioning of the shape.

methods.name: RenderRelativeVertical
methods.description: Renders the relative vertical positioning of the shape.

methods.name: RenderWrapFormat
methods.description: Renders the wrapping style of the shape.

methods.name: RenderParagraphIndents
methods.description: Renders indentation for the shape's paragraph.

methods.name: RenderTopBottom
methods.description: Calculates and renders the top and bottom positions of the shape.

methods.name: AlignVertically
methods.description: Aligns shape vertically based on position and margins.

methods.name: RenderLeftRight
methods.description: Calculates and renders the left and right positions of the shape.

methods.name: AlignHorizontally
methods.description: Aligns shape horizontally based on position and margins.

methods.name: RenderNameValuePair
methods.description: Outputs a shape property as a name-value pair in RTF.

methods.name: StartNameValuePair
methods.description: Begins a shape property in RTF.

methods.name: EndNameValuePair
methods.description: Ends a shape property in RTF.

methods.name: TranslateAsNameValuePair
methods.description: Translates a shape property value into RTF format and outputs it.

methods.name: StartDummyParagraph
methods.description: Begins a paragraph for shape placement.

methods.name: EndDummyParagraph
methods.description: Ends the paragraph for shape placement.
